questions.text: What is supplier on-time delivery by plant region?
questions.sql: SELECT * FROM SEMANTIC_VIEW(ONTOFLAKE.SEMANTIC.SUPPLY_CHAIN DIMENSIONS plant.plant_region METRICS shipment.supplier_otd_pct, shipment.shipment_count)

questions.text: What is our fill rate and backorder quantity by plant?
questions.sql: SELECT * FROM SEMANTIC_VIEW(ONTOFLAKE.SEMANTIC.SUPPLY_CHAIN DIMENSIONS plant.plant_name, plant.plant_region METRICS so_line.fill_rate_pct, so_line.backorder_qty)

questions.text: How many days of inventory do we hold by category at the latest month end?
questions.sql: SELECT * FROM SEMANTIC_VIEW(ONTOFLAKE.SEMANTIC.SUPPLY_CHAIN DIMENSIONS part.category, plant.plant_region, inventory.snapshot_date METRICS inventory.days_of_inventory, inventory.inventory_value_total) WHERE snapshot_date = '2026-06-30'

questions.text: What is landed cost per unit by transport mode?
questions.sql: SELECT * FROM SEMANTIC_VIEW(ONTOFLAKE.SEMANTIC.SUPPLY_CHAIN DIMENSIONS carrier.transport_mode, plant.plant_region METRICS shipment.landed_cost_per_unit, shipment.freight_pct_of_landed)

questions.text: What is customer on-time delivery by month?
questions.sql: SELECT * FROM SEMANTIC_VIEW(ONTOFLAKE.SEMANTIC.SUPPLY_CHAIN DIMENSIONS so_line.order_month, plant.plant_region METRICS so_line.customer_otd_pct, so_line.revenue_total)

questions.text: What is PO spend and purchase price variance by category?
questions.sql: SELECT * FROM SEMANTIC_VIEW(ONTOFLAKE.SEMANTIC.SUPPLY_CHAIN DIMENSIONS part.category, plant.plant_region METRICS po_line.po_spend, po_line.purchase_price_variance)

questions.text: Which suppliers have the worst defect rate?
questions.sql: SELECT * FROM SEMANTIC_VIEW(ONTOFLAKE.SEMANTIC.SUPPLY_CHAIN DIMENSIONS supplier.supplier_name, plant.plant_region METRICS shipment.supplier_defect_rate_pct, shipment.received_qty)

questions.text: What is average supplier lead time by supplier region?
questions.sql: SELECT * FROM SEMANTIC_VIEW(ONTOFLAKE.SEMANTIC.SUPPLY_CHAIN DIMENSIONS supplier.supplier_region, plant.plant_region METRICS shipment.avg_lead_time_days, shipment.supplier_otif_pct)
